integrity: All group-structure statements are derived from the explicit embedding and quotient proved in arXiv:2609.31907v1; no computational enumeration is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the Delta_n family. Originality searches may miss an isomorphic family under unrelated notation. The nilpotency class for 3-power n is not determined.
title: Structure of a new family of dual reflection groups
